items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Earl was in my harmony class and he was in my sight singing class... He was one of my best students.

ctx.x: never would tell anybody that I was a teacher because they played in bands with me and someone
was older than I had. They never would tell anybody that I was a teacher because they would play in bands with me and someone was older than I. And did you ever hear a drummer named Earl Palmer?
